### Fixed

- **Chats no longer freeze when opening or switching.** Opening a chat could hang for 30 seconds or more and end with "Couldn't open chat", most often with a saved DNS tunnel whose server was unreachable. Restarting mail connections no longer blocks chat loading, and DNS-tunnel work no longer runs on the UI thread. Refs #176, #181
- Re-tapping a chat that is still loading waits for the same request instead of starting another one.

### Changed

- Velta Diagnostics names the slow core requests when a chat takes long to open, so stalls can be traced from one log.
